content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The contractual appointments carry fixed monthly remuneration structured as follows: Medical Officer receives Rs. 75,000/-, Dental Officer receives Rs. 75,000/-, Nursing Assistant, Pharmacist, Lab Technician, and Dental Assistant receive Rs. 28,100/- each, while Clerk, Chowkidar, Female Attendant, and Safaiwala receive Rs. 16,800/- each. Appointments are made on a contractual basis for a period of one year for Ex-Servicemen and 11 months for Civilian staff, which is renewable for additional periods of one year or 11 months depending on performance and other conditions. The maximum age limit is 65 years subject to performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECHS Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Download or obtain the application format from the official website echs.gov.in. Fill out the application form with all required personal and educational details. Attach self-attested photocopies of testimonials in support of educational qualifications and work experiences. Send the completed application by post or submit it physically to ECHS Cell, Station Headquarters, Leh. Ensure the application reaches the designated address on or before 20 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies of educational qualification certificates Mark sheets and degree certificates Work experience certificates Degree / Diploma registration certificates where applicable Any other testimonials in support of application claims

faq.question: Q1. What is the contract duration for ECHS Leh recruitment?
faq.answer: The tenure is for a period of one year for Ex-Servicemen and 11 months for Civilian staff, which is renewable for an additional period.

faq.question: Q2. Where should candidates submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit the application form along with self-attested photocopies of testimonials to ECHS Cell, Station Headquarters, Leh.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit applications for ECHS Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of application at Station Headquarters, Leh is 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. When will the interview take place for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled to be conducted in the third week of December 2026 at Station Headquarters, Leh.

faq.question: Q5. What are the fixed monthly remunerations for Medical Officer and Dental Officer?
faq.answer: The fixed monthly remuneration is Rs. 75,000/- for Medical Officer and Rs. 75,000/- for Dental Officer.
